warning: Phase 1 provides explainable candidates only. It does not estimate reductions, costs, savings or payback.

interventions.name: Organic by-product recovery and anaerobic digestion
interventions.short_description: Divert suitable organic waste from disposal into biogas and digestate recovery.
required_conditions: Organic waste composition and current treatment route must be verified.
A compliant digestion or offtake partner must be available.

interventions.name: Packaging reduction, reuse and recycled-content sourcing
interventions.short_description: Reduce virgin packaging demand through lightweighting, returnable formats and verified recycled content.
required_conditions: Packaging material composition and supplier recycled content must be verified.
Product and food-contact requirements must remain compliant.

interventions.name: Refrigerant leak prevention and low-GWP replacement
interventions.short_description: Use leak detection, recovery and a verified lower-impact refrigerant route during servicing or replacement.
required_conditions: Refrigerant type, charge and service history must be confirmed.
Replacement must be compatible with the equipment and applicable safety rules.

interventions.name: Boiler heat recovery and circular fuel substitution
interventions.short_description: Recover usable heat and evaluate a verified waste-derived or renewable fuel route for process heat.
required_conditions: Fuel quality, boiler compatibility and emissions controls must be assessed.
Heat demand and recoverable waste-heat temperatures must be measured.

interventions.name: Purchased electricity efficiency and renewable supply
interventions.short_description: Reduce grid demand through efficient equipment and evaluate on-site or contracted renewable electricity.
required_conditions: Major electrical loads and operating hours must be measured.
Renewable supply claims must use an appropriate accounting boundary.

interventions.name: Transport load consolidation and return logistics
interventions.short_description: Improve load factors and create return routes for packaging, pallets or reusable transport assets.
required_conditions: Shipment lanes, payloads, distances and empty-return rates must be verified.
Reusable asset ownership and hygiene requirements must be defined.
